diagnostic.error_tail:
--- a/launch-verification.sh
+++ b/launch-verification.sh
@@ -1,5 +1,33 @@
 #!/usr/bin/env bash
+# Launch a child process with the bundled native library directory on the
+# dynamic linker search path.
+#
+# The wheel ships a Cython extension with a DT_NEEDED entry for libapriltag.so
+# but no RPATH, so musl's ld.so can only find it via the linker search path.
+# LD_LIBRARY_PATH is read once at process start, hence the export must happen
+# in the parent shell, before exec -- setting os.environ inside Python is too
+# late and RTLD_GLOBAL preloads do not satisfy DT_NEEDED on musl.
 set -euo pipefail
-native_dir=$1
-shift
+
+native_dir=${1:-}
+shift || true
+
+if [[ -z $native_dir ]]; then
+  echo "usage: $0 <native-library-dir> <command> [args...]" >&2
+  exit 2
+fi
+
+if [[ ! -d $native_dir ]]; then
+  echo "warning: native library directory not found: $native_dir" >&2
+fi
+
+# Prepend, never replace: earlier entries win, and the inherited search path
+# for other libraries stays intact. Guard the empty case so we never emit a
+# leading/trailing ':' (an empty component means "current directory").
+if [[ -n ${LD_LIBRARY_PATH:-} ]]; then
+  export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$native_dir:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"
+else
+  export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$native_dir"
+fi
+
 exec "$@"

content.learned: 1) 脚本开头取 native_dir=${1:-} 并 shift，空则报 usage 退 2。2) 在 exec 之前导出：若 LD_LIBRARY_PATH 非空则 export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$native_dir:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH"，否则 export LD_LIBRARY_PATH="$native_dir"——前置而非覆盖，且不得产生空分量（空分量等于当前目录）。3) 导出必须发生在 exec 启动新进程之前；python 内 os.environ 赋值太晚，ctypes RTLD_GLOBAL 预加载在 musl 上不满足 DT_NEEDED。4) 换到另一个库时不要硬编码路径，按该库自己的 site-packages/<pkg> 目录重新定位并替换脚本传入的 native_dir，轮子运行期目录是动态的。5) 改完用原测试命令复跑，断言不仅非空还要保留既有目录。
content.what: 验证启动脚本 launch-verification.sh 接受了原生库目录参数却从未导出 LD_LIBRARY_PATH，子进程环境为空，依赖 libapriltag.so 的导入仍报 Error loading shared library。3 个启动环境测试全部失败。
content.where: 来源档案 am-347d912831feb751855892df（migbot-experience-raw），固定提交 343c60fd2309dbf1edf6d3169b80838c54e1f1cd；apriltag-python 3.4.5，原生库目录 venv/lib/python3.12/site-packages/apriltag。
content.why: 脚本只做 native_dir=$1; shift; exec "$@"，参数被丢弃。而 musl 下 DT_NEEDED 只能经动态链接器搜索路径解析，LD_LIBRARY_PATH 仅在进程启动时读取一次，父 shell 不导出就再无补救机会；带 RPATH 缺失的 wheel 不会自动找到同目录 .so。

+++ b/launch-verification.sh
@@ -1,5 +1,33 @@

-shift

+  exit 2
+fi

+fi

note.title: apriltag-python 3.4.5: launcher ignored native dir arg, LD_LIBRARY_PATH never exported to child
